# ADR-0007: Synthetic test runs with an answer key written in advance

**Decision:** The examples use two invented test runs, generated by [`tools/generate_synthetic.py`](../../tools/generate_synthetic.py). The expected findings are written before any agent runs. Their SHA-256 hash is committed before the runs, so anyone can verify the answer key was not changed afterwards.

**Why:** Real test results belong to employers and customers and cannot be published. Synthetic results with an answer key written in advance let anyone check whether the agents found what was there and avoided the misleading signals.

**Limits:** The same author designed the test runs and the agent checklists, so the runs exercise patterns the checklists already cover. They show the workflow working on cases it was designed for, not on unseen production results.

**Revisit when:** authorized, anonymized real results are available for an independent evaluation.
